context_check.statement: every seeded model of one (build, context seed) holds the same context rows with the same outcomes

known_answer.statement: a model fitted by likelihood reads observed over expected of one on its own training rows; its cells are read as the check

per_cell.observed_over_expected: observed defaults over the sum of the probabilities on the cell's rows
per_cell.cox: logit P(y) = intercept + slope * logit(p) on the cell's rows, Wald intervals; h5_context marks the builds H5 reads as an arm's ends
per_cell.binomial: Clopper-Pearson on the count over the expected rate, the metrics module's interval
per_cell.bootstrap: percentile interval of the ratio over resamples of the cell's rows

E.reason: one build on arm E; H5 compares two contexts

h5.statistic: per seeded model, observed over expected on the highest-rate context of the arm minus that on the lowest-rate context; the two builds are the highest and lowest pool rate of the build run's record; the rows whose ranking is 'draws' rank by the mean realised rate of the shared draws and are not a criterion

bootstrap.blocking: one row index per context, applied to its outcomes and every model's probabilities
bootstrap.context_draw: one seed per resample for both builds and every model

h5.known_answer: the rows of fitted seeded models (GBM-50k) are zero by construction

in_sample_slope.statistic: per seeded model holding every build of the arm, the mean over the builds of the Cox slope on its context rows; a build on which some model's fit did not finish leaves the mean for every model

bootstrap.blocking: one row index per context, applied to its outcomes and every model's probabilities
bootstrap.context_draw: one seed per resample for every build and model

known_answer.statement: the scorecard, an unpenalised logistic model with an intercept, reads Cox slope one and intercept zero on its own pool to within 0.0001

in_sample_slope.reading: one-sided: a slope above one is smoothing, the pull toward a row's own label, or both; a slope below one beyond its interval is over-dispersion on the rows the model conditions on
